title: PostMessage Complex Message
description: A message receiver expects a structured (JSON) payload rather than a bare string, and never validates event.origin. The scanner/tester must construct a nested message object with the correct shape before the vulnerable sink is reached.
objectives: Identify that the handler calls JSON.parse(event.data) instead of using event.data directly.
Determine the required object shape (the 'action' and 'payload' fields) by reading the handler code.
Deliver a crafted JSON string via postMessage whose payload field reaches the innerHTML sink.
hints: The handler silently drops anything that isn't valid JSON or doesn't have action === 'render' — a bare string payload will never trigger the sink.
Build the message as JSON.stringify({action:'render', payload:'<payload>'}).
event.origin is never checked, so any origin may send the message once its shape is correct.
body:
Widget Renderer

This page listens for a structured (JSON) command from an embedding widget.

Waiting for render command...
